product.title: Catacombs of Paris Semi-Private VIP Restricted Access Tour

description.text: Explore the Catacombs of Paris on a small-group tour limited to only six people. With this skip-the-line admission, you can avoid the typically long ticket queue at one of Paris' most fascinating attractions, and learn about the history of the underground burial site with a guide. Stops include Catacombs of Paris, Rue Rémy Dumoncel. Local commentary and route logistics are handled so you can focus on Paris landmarks, river views, and neighborhood walking or cycling highlights. Ideal for visitors basing in Paris who want a guided city experience without coordinating Metro routes, attraction tickets, or landmark timing on their own. Routes stay oriented to Catacombs of Paris, Rue Rémy Dumoncel that define this Paris sightseeing experience, with a guide handling Metro connections, ticket windows, and neighborhood pacing so the day stays focused on the city rather than logistics.
